title: Duotone photo poster with a luminance flash
summary: A still aerial photo mapped to two greens holds under a two-line headline, a URL line and a round arrow button; once per loop a posterized light pass flares the highlights for about half a second, so the static poster reads as alive.
use_when: A vertical social ad or story built from one strong photo
A looping poster where nothing should move except a single accent
Brand colour has to own a stock or product photo
A silent autoplay placement with one headline and one link

look.type_style: bold geometric grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking, two-line headline top left at ~6 % H per line; small uppercase medium footer line bottom left ~1.6 % H

sfx.event: posterized light pass flares over the photo

structure.shot: full-bleed top-down city photo in two greens; 2-line headline top left, small URL line bottom left, white round arrow button bottom right
structure.camera: static (zoom 0.02 %/s, pan ≤ 1 px/s @1920 from motion.json: no measurable move)
structure.motion: photo and type hold; light pass at f33: highlights jump to a posterized bright green, peak f34–f38, easings.outExpo decay to clean by ~f45, faint residue to ~f54 (±0.25 s at the tail); type and button never move

params.brand: any brand.json: bg (duotone shadow), accent (duotone highlight), fg for type and the button
params.content.photo: one high-detail photo (aerial or texture-rich works best), cover-cropped per aspect
params.content.headline: 2 lines, 3 words each at most, sentence case
params.content.footer: small uppercase line with the URL, ≤ 4 words
params.content.button: show the round arrow button (default true)
params.timing.passAt: frame of the light pass at 30 fps (default 33)
params.timing.passFrames: length of the pass incl. decay (default 12, residue to 21)
params.fps: composition fps (default 30); timing scales with it

notes: One shot, no cuts, silent; loops (last cell = first). Measured from a 30 fps strip 0.90–1.90 s: pass onset f33, brightest f34–f38, decays by ~f45, residue flecks to ~f54; motion.json shows diff only in second 1–2. The pass is posterized (hard luminance steps), strongest on the foliage top left, not a directional sweep. Proposed term luma-flash (not in vocabulary, not used as an id). Theme: mean luma 0.31-0.34 (between dark and light thresholds); dark chosen since the shadow tone dominates and type is light. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured.
